description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is a global aerospace, defense, and security company developing radar, missile defense, and other mission-critical technologies. The Software Engineer will join an Agile team to design, develop, test, integrate, and sustain real-time processing software while applying established software development standards and processes. The role also involves managing Red Hat Enterprise Linux systems and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD SECRET security clearance.
Business application software engineer for design, development, testing, debugging, and standards compliance

Responsibilities:
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• • Bachelor's level degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field with minimum 1 year related professional experience
• • Experience with deploying and managing/administrating Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) systems
• • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD Security Clearance at the SECRET level

Preferred:
• • Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux - RHEL8.*, RHEL 9.*
• • Experience with Gitlab, Atlassian toolset, Bash Scripting and Containers (Podman/Docker)
• • Engineering design and development, software development processes and Systems/Software modeling
• • Ability to work independently or as a member of a team
• • Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment, Test Automation, and Agile development experience
• • Design and development of radar systems
• • Flexibility to travel if needed
